description: Optimize the geometry of an oxygen molecule in its triplet ground state.
user_prompt: Optimize the geometry of an oxygen molecule, then report the final energy and O-O bond length.

method.modeling: Gas-phase O2 molecule in its triplet ground state, in a cubic box with at least 12 Angstrom vacuum separation.
method.rationale: The target O-O bond length is the PAW/PBE value reported by Han (2022) for the triplet O2 ground state. The reference uses a 600 eV cutoff and a 23 x 22 x 21 Angstrom molecular cell. Only the O-O bond length is scored because the absolute molecular total energy is sensitive to PAW dataset, cell conventions, and spin setup. The +/-0.02 Angstrom tolerance covers ordinary PAW/PBE setup and relaxation-threshold differences.
